title: phaseolus pluriflorus
intro: Phaseolus pluriflorus, commonly known as the Chinese wax bean or Chinese bush bean, is a type of legume native to Asia. This plant is known for its edible beans and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Phaseolus pluriflorus include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and provide antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can be used to treat various ailments.
